stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: Keep the counts, and lose none.

stations.title: Old stock script
stations.text: Writes the whole file on every change.
stations.note: A stop leaves half of it.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper wants the stock counts kept, after two half-empty files.
The old script writes the whole file on every change, and a stop leaves half.
You write a store that keeps text values under text keys, in three tasks.
Now the counter asks for card and gets its count back, and knows a missing key.
Same shop, same counts, and a store that is the start of a database.
